issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation 'Đức Chúa Trời là Cha' (God is Father) changes the Greek structure 'απο θεου πατρος' (from God, [who is] Father). The Greek indicates the source of grace/peace is from God the Father; the Vietnamese phrasing suggests a definition of God as Father rather than the source of the blessing.

The Vietnamese translation omits 'Κυρίου' (Lord) preceding 'ημων' (our). While it mentions 'Chúa Giê-xu', the specific construction 'Lord of our Jesus Christ' is simplified to 'Jesus Christ is our Lord'.
